title: Staging→Excel Projection Map v1.0
description: Schema for the projection-map document that binds SQLite staging tables/views to Excel logical sheets and declares the projection strategy. Consumed by excel_project_sf / excel_project_* at Stage 3 of the SF pipeline. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §6.1 (Stage 3 — Projection) and §11.3 (per-sheet projection_mode).

default_write_order_policy.description: Used when multiple mappings target the same sheet without explicit write_order values

mappings.description: Ordered list of staging→excel projections. Each mapping describes ONE source→sheet projection pass.

sourceKind.description: Classifies the source_table — raw_table is a base staging table; *_view is a SQL VIEW; config_json is a project config artifact read directly (dashboard KPIs); mcp_staging_table is written by a non-SF MCP feed (gsc, dataforseo, scrapling)

projectionMode.description: Named strategy the projection tool recognizes. Must match one listed in excel-source-manifest.schema.json sheetEntry.projection_mode values.

transform.description: Per-column transform applied at projection time. url_normalize runs the CSR-D-03 canonicalizer; status_cast maps stored statusEnum to write-time statusDisplay.

writerName.description: Writer actor — MUST match an allowed_writers entry in excel-source-manifest.json for the target_sheet

excel_col.description: Excel column letter(s) — references master-excel-schema.json column definitions for the target sheet

source_expression.description: SQL expression, column name, or JSON pointer (when source_kind=config_json)

kpiCellTarget.description: Used exclusively when projection_mode=kpi_cells (dashboard sheet). Maps one staging aggregate to one cell.

compute.description: Named compute identifier (count_pillars, count_rows, count_status_done, now_date_string, ...)

write_order.description: Ordering within Stage 3; lower writes first. Critical for sheets with multiple source feeds (e.g. tech_seo aggregates from 3 staging tables).

target_columns.description: Column-level mapping. Used by every projection_mode EXCEPT kpi_cells.

kpi_cells.description: Cell-level mapping. Used by projection_mode=kpi_cells only.

filter_sql.description: Optional WHERE clause (without the WHERE keyword) applied at read time — e.g. 'status_code IN (301,302,404)'

dedup_on.description: Column names used for row-level deduplication before write

truncate_target_before_write.description: When true, clears the sheet data rows (keeping header) before projection writes. Reserved for full-refresh projections; merge/append modes must keep false.

protected_columns_passthrough.description: When true, preserves values in protected_columns (per excel-source-manifest.json) during a row-level update

freshness_sla_hours.description: Max staging_table age before projection warns (overrides per-sheet SLA from source manifest)
